whenToUse: You convey a single share simply, such as a survey result.
You want a share to feel like a number of people.
There are one to three items.
whenNotToUse: Shares precise to decimals (show the number).
There are four or more items (use a bar chart).
Comparing the shares of several groups (use a stacked bar chart).

alternatives.name: Stacked Bar Chart
alternatives.reason: Comparing several groups side by side.

accessibility: The grid is aria-hidden, and the legend lists every share in text.
Cells fill in the same order as the legend.
It says in words what one cell is worth.
